features.feature: JSONL record type: four cache-aware token fields (inputTokens=uncached remainder, outputTokens, cacheCreationInputTokens, cacheReadInputTokens) with NO stored totalTokens
usage.source discriminator enum (provider-reported | prompt-size-estimate | unavailable) on each record
Per-dimension cache absence encoded as null (never 0, never expressed via usage.source overloading)
Schema validator: rejects stored totalTokens, enforces required fields, rejects malformed records
Correlation fields: ledgerCallId, attemptId, sequence (monotonic), supersedesRecordIds (required, may be empty array)
Correlation ids minted locally BEFORE any provider dispatch; must NOT derive from provider.requestIdHash
supersedesRecordIds wiring: a later record for the same attempt can supersede an earlier one
Append-only writer to .lattice/usage/llm-usage.jsonl (exactly one JSON line per append, never rewrites prior lines)
Hash chain: previousRecordHash read from last line, recordHash computed per record
Writer is a complete no-op when opt-in flag is OFF (default OFF per Rollout Phase 2)
Runtime rejection of raw prompt, raw completion, raw transcript, raw tool arguments, provider secrets, customer API keys, actor keys, authorization headers
Registration of .lattice/usage/llm-usage.jsonl in runtime-artifact-registry.ts (id=llm-usage-ledger, matchers, ignorePatterns, materialHash=exclude, volatile=true, repairableTrackedArtifact=true)
Opt-in flag gating with default OFF so writer is fully inert by default

Informational summary reader: derives total=inputTokens+outputTokens+cacheCreationInputTokens+cacheReadInputTokens, selects latest non-superseded record per ledgerCallId+attemptId, keeps estimates out of provider-reported totals, reports unavailable/null as unknown (never zero), feeds NO gate
Smoke/test suite wired into package.json covering all foundation behaviors
Provider adapter extraction and multi-provider normalization (Slice 2 per spec)
features.excluded_by: Story description: NO provider adapters; plan.md: Out of scope — Provider adapters / live dispatch
